scope: 21 existing stereo-supported cases; 8 previous unsupported cases explicitly retained, no new independent validation or ETH3D five-view claim
routing: pre-GT P3 manifests only; GT/previous GT-derived metric containers never enter fitting
fixed_inputs: original masks, RGB images, provided cameras, raw depths and FIT-RGB common scale; original B2/B3 initialization produced without GT
objective: forward source0-to-target1 planar RGB warp, radial RGB Huber delta=0.03 on [0,1] sRGB; global scalar gain and bias fitted with geometry, gain [0.7,1.3], bias [-0.15,0.15]; no feature-coordinate residual in P9b/c
direction: forward photometric fit only, one canonical source pixel partition avoids forward/reverse physical observation split leakage
support: fixed source pixels inside source mask eroded4px; source-to-target warp under BOTH original B2 and B3 inside target mask eroded9px; support frozen before photometric optimization, never dropped according to current residual

split.assignment: hash seed0 of dataset:sample:tile_x:tile_y, <3 of10 heldout, otherwise FIT; same source pixels used across arms
split.sample: deterministic uniform flattened-index selection, no texture/GT-based selection

texture_gate.policy: numerically degenerate arm retains original B2 with explicit reason; low texture diagnostic, not an accuracy probability

optimizer.trust_region: source polygon corner target coordinates within +/-3px per coordinate of original B2; original masks/points not altered; verify all dense source ROI pixels after solving

P9b: original B1 direction fixed, distance only; initial original B2, original B1 only if trust admissible
P9c: plane direction and distance free within same warp trust region; starts original B2, B3, and raw B1 only if admissible; lowest final FIT photometric objective among successful starts
P9a: refit gain/bias on FIT only at original B2/B3; evaluate heldout warp error and visualize. GT reference plane warp evaluated ONLY after all fits as oracle diagnostic, never initialization or selection.
P9d: report source texture, projected photo-Jacobian rank, affine brightness parameters at bounds, high-residual fraction, support/target footprint and trust boundary. No real occlusion GT: label high residual as appearance mismatch, not proven occlusion. No residual-driven deletion, no per-case GT-best arm selector.
retention: support/texture/solver/positive-depth/trust failure retains original B2 for the affected arm; failed proposals/logs preserved; common support and successful-only plus all-retained metrics reported
evaluation: all GT reads strictly post-fit; existing P4 GT arrays/reference reused. Report primary P9c-vs-P9b paired depth/normal and photometric losses, P9b-vs-B2, P9c-vs-B3; already-seen exploratory cases, ID bootstrap descriptive only. Report spatially unidentifiable cases, do not lower thresholds.
matched_trust_control: F9C_MATCH_TRUST: original FIT correspondence objective with exactly the same +/-3px warp-corner trust and positive-depth constraints; separates search-region restriction from photometric objective effects
heldout_scope: photometric pixels not used for P9 refinement, with spatial guards; original RGB/model/LK initialization may already encode these observations, not a fresh independent test
